newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas firms slightly but only 50 lots done.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas firms slightly but only 50 lots done.

text.p: The IPE natural gas contract saw prices firm slightly on Monday, but only six deals, totalling 50 lots, were traded over the whole day.

The only months traded were April, with three deals and 15 lots, September with two trades and 30 lots, and February, with a single five-lot trade. The minimum trade size is five lots, or 5,000 therms a day for a month.
The price rises were modest, all between 0.050 pence and 0.10 pence a therm up from Friday's settlement price.

But brokers had been expecting prices to slip still further after several days of weak levels. Oversupply, lack of storage and a lack of large maintenance programmes were all cited as bearish factors, and Monday's upward adjustment was seen as a temporary blip.
